name: Atlassian
description: Atlassian's Rovo MCP server covers Jira and Confluence Cloud: search with JQL or CQL, read and create issues and pages, and comment. It acts with your Atlassian permissions.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (auth.atlassian.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
